001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import java.util.Map;
004import java.util.Objects;
005
006/**
007 * Settings chosen for a bot opponent, for example its difficulty. Immutable.
008 * The core does not interpret {@link #values()}; it passes them back to the {@link BotProvider}.
009 *
010 * @param label Plain display name shown to players, for example "Normal". 1-32 characters, no MiniMessage tags.
011 * @param values Provider-defined settings, for example {@code difficulty=3}. Copied, never null.
012 */
013public record BotOptions(String label, Map<String, String> values) {
014
015    public BotOptions {
016        Objects.requireNonNull(label, "label");
017        Objects.requireNonNull(values, "values");
018        if (label.isBlank() || label.length() > 32 || label.indexOf('<') >= 0 || label.indexOf('>') >= 0) {
019            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bot option label must be 1-32 characters of plain text");
020        }
021        values = Map.copyOf(values);
022    }
023
024}
